summary: Recursively frees a tree/graph structure rooted at a1. Validates the root with NullCheckWrapper, walks the child list through each node's second dword (sibling/next pointer) and recurses on every node, then derives a secondary sub-object with ShortComputation_adb0 and recurses on it if present. Finally runs DualPointerCleanup on the root and releases it with FreeWrapper_7bcf.

operations.description: Do nothing unless the root pointer a1 is non-null.
Validate the root node with NullCheckWrapper(a1, 0); the walk cursor is seeded from its result.
Walk the child/sibling list while the cursor v2 is non-null, advancing through each node's second dword (v2[1]) as the next link.
Recurse on each node of the child list, freeing it via the same routine.
Derive a secondary sub-object pointer from the root a1 via ShortComputation_adb0(a1).
If the derived secondary sub-object v4 is non-null, free it recursively.
Recurse on the secondary sub-object v4 through the same free routine.
Run DualPointerCleanup(a1) on the root to release its dual-pointer members.
Release the root node's memory with FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1).

unresolved: Node structure is unknown: the meaning of the second dword link and the object returned by ShortComputation_adb0 depend on an unevidenced owner layout.
The decompiled source's `v1` (NullCheckWrapper result) is an uninitialized-looking register alias; the walk cursor is treated as derived from the validated root.
Relation of DualPointerCleanup/FreeWrapper_7bcf ownership is caller-specific and not evidenced here.
